description: 警戒水位值 [flood] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 河川警戒水位係依水利法第七十四條：主管機關應酌量歷年水勢，決定設防之水位或日期。 水利法施行細則第五十二條：本法第七十四條第一項所稱設防之水位，指由主管機關公告分級之警戒水位。 河川管理辦法第二十六條：每一河川之警戒水位，由各該主管機關訂定並公告之。 因此，依水利法施行細則第五十二條將警戒水位分為三級，並依各級警戒水位應採行措施分別訂定其... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
